tasks.text: The file repeats 집행률 82%. Which object is the shape (not the note) that holds those words, and what group is it in? Answer as `ANSWER: <shape name> | <group name>`.

Write a new workbook with exactly one sheet 메모, range A1:D8, containing: a table 메모표 on A1:B3 with columns 사업 (text) and 집행률 (number, format 0%); a shape named 제목 anchored C1:D2 text "주간 집행"; a group named 표시 of two shapes, 양호 at C4:D5 text "양호" and 주의 at C6:D7 text "주의". No other items.
Add a shape named 마감 안내, anchored B23:D24, with text "10월 마감은 11월 5일입니다."
Move 표 제목 so its anchor is A18:C19. Keep its text "2026 사업별 집행".
Change the text of 증가 화살표 to "집행률 85%". Do not edit the note that says 집행률 82%.
Resize 입력 안내 so its anchor is B20:E23. Keep its text.
Turn 증가 화살표 into a right-arrow preset (kind=rightArrow) filled accent1, with a 2 pt outline.
